rationale_summary: The document is primarily framed around protecting the rights of the American public, explicitly invoking a 'Bill of Rights' framing and centering on rights, opportunities, and access. Governance is justified by the need to safeguard individuals against harms to their civil liberties and fundamental rights.

evidence_spans.quote: a set of five principles and associated practices to help guide the design, use, and deployment of automated systems to protect the rights of the American public

evidence_spans.source_section: How these principles can move into practice
